description: This file defines a SwiftUI extension to track the width of views via a preference key and includes a debugging/testing utility for width reduction.

classes.name: ViewWidthPreferenceKey
classes.description: A PreferenceKey implementation to pass view width information up the view hierarchy.

classes.name: ViewMetricsTesting
classes.description: A utility enum used during debugging to help reduce and compare view widths.

methods.name: reduce
methods.description: Defines how to combine multiple view width values during preference reduction.

methods.name: onWidthChange
methods.description: A View extension method that adds a listener for when the view's width changes.

methods.name: reduceWidth
methods.description: A static method used in testing to compute the reduced width.
